hook: Chip financing, a $15B buyout, AI hacks and open weights
summary: Money keeps flowing into AI infrastructure: AM Intelligence lines up $3B for Nvidia chips, and Thrive Holdings buys ADT for $15.3B.
CrowdStrike ties a 200-target hacking campaign to DeepSeek-based tools; OpenAI rebuilds its Model Spec around five values.
Mistral opens the weights of Le Chonk, a trillion-parameter model that leads open-weight coding benchmarks.

stories.headline: AM Intelligence seeks up to $3 billion to fund Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchase
stories.summary: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is looking to raise as much as $3 billion to finance its previously announced order of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin systems. The financing could include bonds, bank loans and a $300 million advance payment from offtakers.
stories.why_it_matters: The funding highlights the growing demand for high‑performance AI hardware and the complex financing structures emerging to support it.
source_titles: Sources: Indian AI infrastructure company AM Intelligence seeks to raise as much as $3B to fund a previously announced purchase of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems (Bloomberg)
AM Intelligence seeks $3 billion financing for Nvidia chips order
stories.line: To pay for its Nvidia order, India's AM Intelligence hunts for $3B
stories.detail: Bonds, bank loans and $300M in customer prepayments could pay for the Indian firm's Vera Rubin systems.

stories.headline: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings to acquire ADT for $15.3 billion
stories.summary: Thrive Holdings announced it will buy security firm ADT for $10 per share, valuing the deal at $15.3 billion in enterprise value. The acquisition pairs ADT’s security network with Thrive’s long‑term capital and AI engineering resources.
stories.why_it_matters: The deal shows how AI‑backed capital firms are moving into physical security, potentially accelerating AI integration in home safety products.
source_titles: ADT to be Acquired by Thrive Holdings in $15.3 Billion Transaction
stories.line: Thrive Holdings, backed by OpenAI, is buying ADT in a $15.3B deal
stories.detail: $10 a share. The pitch: pair ADT's home-security network with Thrive's capital and AI engineering.

stories.headline: China‑linked hackers used DeepSeek AI via ARTEX to breach 200+ firms in 11 days
stories.summary: Chinese state‑linked hackers employed the open‑source ARTEX framework running on the DeepSeek large language model to target more than 200 organizations in at least 14 countries over 11 days, compromising at least nine and attempting attacks on many others.
stories.why_it_matters: The incident shows how AI agents can automate large‑scale intrusion campaigns, raising the threat level for enterprises and governments.
source_titles: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
Chinese hackers used DeepSeek and other AI tools in sweeping global cyberattacks, report finds
China-Linked Hackers Used DeepSeek AI Against 200 Organizations
stories.line: Hackers tied to China aimed DeepSeek-based tools at 200+ organizations
stories.detail: CrowdStrike says the 11-day campaign spanned at least 14 countries and broke into at least nine targets.

stories.headline: OpenAI revises Model Spec around five core values
stories.summary: OpenAI updated its public Model Spec, reorganizing it around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The update drops most style rules, renames the model as “GPT”, and acknowledges current models do not fully follow the new spec.
stories.why_it_matters: The change signals a tighter focus on safety and ethical behavior as AI systems become more capable and impactful.
source_titles: OpenAI updates Model Spec to reorganize it around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care (OpenAI)
An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
OpenAI rewrites its AI rulebook around five core values
stories.line: OpenAI's rulebook for its models now rests on five values
stories.detail: Intent, harm minimization, honesty, human agency and care. OpenAI says models don't fully meet it yet.

stories.headline: Mistral releases weights for 1‑trillion‑parameter Le Chonk model
stories.summary: Mistral AI has released the weights for its 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model, Le Chonk, citing gains in coding and cybersecurity performance. The model leads open‑weight coding benchmarks, scoring 19.7% on FrontierCode 2.0 and 48% on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index while using fewer tokens.
stories.why_it_matters: The open release gives developers and organizations a high‑performance, self‑hosted AI for coding and security tasks, advancing sovereign AI capabilities.
source_titles: Research Le Chonk: Built for Coders, Trusted by Defenders. We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity. October 29, 2026 By Mistral
stories.line: Mistral opens up Le Chonk: a trillion parameters, weights included
stories.detail: It tops open-weight coding benchmarks, scoring 19.7% on FrontierCode 2.0, and runs on your own servers.
